text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Good job♪ Just tap-tap 
gently, like Chiyo-chan showed you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: "...Ho-ho-ho. How utterly embarrassing..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
To think that we, who departed the 
"Victory Club" the other day... would now 
be guiding these young sprouts like this—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
...? Bakushin O...? Is something the 
matter...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...No! It's nothing! Come on! Let's go 
too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And that's the horseshoe check done! 
Alright, what's next...

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Time for the Victory Club Calisthenics~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
A perfect run starts with a perfect 
warm-up... One, two, three, four... Five, 
six, victory.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Five, six, victory!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Five, six, victory!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! Good job, everyone♪ Next up is 
gate practice. Gather in front of the 
gates~!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Muu?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"All right, let's do this! On your mark, 
get set..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa! Class Rep is so faaast! —Just like 
a rockeeet!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Indeed! What an exemplary 
start! As expected of myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is everyone's turn! Start 
getting ready~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Mmm?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnnngh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. If you do not eat properly, 
your 'blood' and 'fluids' will deplete, 
and your 'qi' will be thrown into 
disarray."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Rather than that, Baku-chan. You've 
had your head in the clouds all day. Is 
something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... My head's been all... fuzzy this 
whole time! Like something's missing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what could it be? The flow of 
training was the same as always, too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Training? Always... the 
same..................... SaMe?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Aaaaghh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I just remembered! I forgot something! I 
left something important behind!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'll go grab it real quick! Bakushiiiiin!

On a day off. While spending some 
leisurely time in my room...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —TRAINER-SAAAAN!!!! ARE YOU THEEEERE????

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! Thank goodness! You're here!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's head right back! To our 
beloved 'Victory Club'!
choice_data_list:
...All right, could you explain it to me 
from square one?

...All right, can you explain it to me 
from the beginning?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Pres! ...Huh? Who's that 
with you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! This is my Trainer!

Though I received an explanation, I 
couldn't quite grasp the point... In the 
end, I arrived here still not really 
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... How fitting. So the "item" you 
left behind was... your Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Baku-chan dashed off, saying, 'I 
forgot something really important!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Where there's a carrot, there's an 
Umamusume!" ...To Bakushin O-san, 
Trainer-san is just that important, isn't 
he!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiin!
choice_data_list: Your form's looking great, Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right? Exactly! Then allow me to show you 
once more!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu! Look, look at Baku-chan's face. 
She looks so full of life♪

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, hey! Trainer-san, why did you 
become Class Rep's Trainer? What do you 
like about Class Rep?"
choice_data_list:
I guess I'm kind of like haru-ichiban, the 
first wind of spring

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! So you love watching this Class Rep 
run after all, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: To me, you're one of a kind.
To me, you're one of a kind.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: One of a kind! I see, that's fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then you are one of a kind to me as well! 
Please take pride in that! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mm! I sense that I was just praised! What 
did you say just now!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! I see, I see! ...So, what does that 
mean specifically?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Haru Ichiban... the fierce yet warm wind 
heralding the arrival of spring. 
...Hohoho. How fitting... It is truly 
beautiful.
